crossRefs.note: If a man is found lying with a woman married to a husband, then they shall both die, the man who lay with the woman and…
For jealousy arouses the fury of the husband. He won’t spare in the day of vengeance.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: The woman conceived; and she sent and told David, and said, “I am with child.”
translations.bsb: And the woman conceived and sent word to David, saying, “I am pregnant.”
translations.kjv: And the woman conceived, and sent and told David, and said, I am with child.
translations.asv: And the woman conceived; and she sent and told David, and said, I am with child.
